text_zh: 深圳市城市管理和综合执法局的莲花山公园资料列示开放时段为6:00至23:00，22:30停止入园。本条仅指普通步行游园，不含停车、献花报备、活动报名或园内专项设施，也不保证当天或全园每个区域开放；行前另核天气、临时关闭及最新公告。普通游园是否须预约、有无常规每周闭园日及提前预约窗口，本条均未经官方来源核定，不能把开放时段当作免预约或每天开放的保证。
text_en: Shenzhen’s urban management bureau lists Lianhua Hill Park’s hours as 6 am to 11 pm, with last entry at 10:30 pm. This record covers ordinary walking only, excluding parking, flower-laying arrangements, events and individual facilities, and does not guarantee access that day or to every area. Check weather, temporary closures and current notices before travelling. Whether ordinary visits need a reservation, whether there is a regular weekly closing day and any advance-booking window are not confirmed by an official source here; the listed hours do not establish reservation-free or daily access.
